summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) containing its October 2026 Monthly Return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, filed under HK Listing Rule 13.25B. The return shows authorized share capital unchanged at 32,000,000,000 ordinary shares (par US$0.000003125) and issued shares flat at 19,901,959,514 with no treasury shares; public float sufficiency is confirmed above the 25% threshold. No transaction, price, premium or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine securities-movement disclosure with no special-situations angle; watch only for dilution from share-option exercises.
